title: Tell me you eat fish: gharial
storyboard: Film: creator does the 'tell me without telling me' trend, miming a long snout with both arms
caption:
That snout is a fishing tool.

Adult gharials primarily eat fish, while juveniles also take insects, crustaceans and frogs. The opening photo is a wild female in Bardiya National Park, Nepal.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo (Gharial).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
